data.one_liner: A widget that animates the opacity of its child on touch events, similar to React Native.
data.what_it_does: Provides a TouchableOpacity widget that wraps a GestureDetector and animates the opacity of the child when touch events occur. It allows configuring properties like activeOpacity to customize the visual feedback.
use_when: You want React Native-style opacity feedback on touch interactions.
You need a simple wrapper widget to add visual feedback to touchable items.
avoid_when: You need standard Material ink splash or ripple effects instead of opacity changes.
strengths: Easy to drop in and use similarly to other Flutter widgets.
Maintains standard GestureDetector behaviors and interactions.
weaknesses: Fills its parent by default, requiring a layout widget to bound its size to its child.
Not documented with any advanced features beyond basic opacity animation.
